# Vision Driven Design (VDD)

> Open-source (MIT) spec-driven development methodology and MCP server for AI coding agents. VDD turns a human vision statement into a fully traced delivery chain across 8 phases and 7 quality gates, with bi-directional Vision → Strategy → Tactics → Specs → Plan → Tasks (V→S→T→SP→PL→TK) traceability. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, VS Code and other MCP clients.

## Connect

- Hosted MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no API key): https://vdd.simonmak.com/api/mcp
- Local stdio server: `npx -y @simonmak-ascent/mcp`
- Hosted mode is stateless with no filesystem: artifact phases return `persisted:false` + `writeTargets` for the agent to write, and filesystem-dependent tools (tactics/clarify/get-next-task/inspect/validate/implement) return a `delegation` envelope — re-call the same tool with `artifactFiles` (and `codebaseAudit` for tactics) for the real result, or use the local stdio server.
- Official MCP Registry name: `io.github.simonmak-ascent/vision-driven-design`
- Glama listing: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/simonmak-ascent/vision-driven-design
- Context7 library ID: `/simonmak-ascent/vision-driven-design`

## MCP tools (15)

- `vdd_init`: Phase 0, write constitution.md (run first)
- `vdd_vision`, `vdd_strategize`, `vdd_tactics`: Phases 1-3, vision, research-backed strategy, codebase audit
- `vdd_specify`, `vdd_clarify`: Phase 4, specs with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, then clarification
- `vdd_plan`, `vdd_tasks`: Phases 5-6, technical blueprint and test-first task list
- `vdd_get_next_task`, `vdd_implement`: Phase 7, next task and implementation instructions (host agent edits code)
- `vdd_validate`: Phase 8, traceability matrix, drift and orphan detection, 7 gates
- `vdd_inspect`: read-only project or feature inspection
- `vdd_amend`: plan a requirement-change cascade through the chain
- `vdd_clone`: capture a target domain into a clone dataset and manifest
- `vdd_detect_environment`: report required vs available host tools per phase
